#### What's great

Slashy does a really good job of actually writing emails that sound like me. It's also just a really good email client, and the AI is really useful and has the right context when I ask it questions. I was a bit of a skeptic, and coming from Superhuman, I expected some limitations, but after having used Slashy for a month now, it's obvious that those limitations aren't real, and I'm leaning on it more and more today. It's probably the reason I was able to raise money because I was so on top of my email.
